name: Survivor leg
description: One leg of the survivor caste, hinged at the origin: the hip sits at [0,0] and the limb hangs down +y, so a `rot` track swings it the way a leg swings rather than turning it about its own middle. One tapered shaft, a knee plate, and a tarsal claw that points forward (+x) — the survivors walk on the same clawed feet the rest of the hive does, they have simply stood up on two of them. Cold slate throughout: the survivors' bare chitin is the dead grey of their organ, and whatever colour they carry is plate worn over it, never the body itself. `far` is the leg on the other side of the body, a step darker so the pair reads as depth rather than as two legs on one hip.

far.description: The leg on the far side of the body: no ink line, a step darker, so it sits behind the near one instead of beside it.
